name: cam-01-to-etsi-cam-defaults
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. A GeoJSON Feature holding a position and an id only. etsicam.station_id 12345 derives from uid "12345" by parse_int (model/etsicam.def). Encode: protocolVersion 2 and every mandatory component of the basic and high-frequency containers from the pack's defaults (positionConfidenceEllipse 4095/4095/3601, altitude 800001 unavailable, heading 3601/127, speed 16383/127, driveDirection unavailable, length 1023/unavailable, width 62, acceleration 161/102, curvature 1023/unavailable, curvatureCalculationMode unavailable, yaw rate 32767/unavailable); stationType and generationDeltaTime have no value and no default and are written as their lower bound 0 (ruling 1 of 0.19); no alt has content, so alt 0 is written; no OPTIONAL is present. lat round(48.2 * 10000000 / 1) = 482000000. 322 bits. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
